verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented commitment or setting that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. The only related item is a tenant-level toggle for whether AI features are available (firehydrant-docs-14). That is an adjacent control over feature use, not a training opt-out or no-training guarantee, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
